source.prompt: Square, 2048x2048. Orthographic view of a single cut-out object centred in the frame, on a solid flat bright magenta (#ff00ff) background that fills everything outside the object, with no shadow cast on the background. Flat, even, shadowless lighting: no highlights, no vignette. No perspective, no text, no border, no watermark. Object: a single tussock of red oat grass (Themeda triandra) seen from the side: a dense base of fine leaves, arching stems carrying drooping clusters of large rust-red to bronze awned spikelets with long twisted dark awns, the leaves turning from green at the base to red-bronze at the tips. Keep colours natural but slightly muted and even, so the texture can be tinted to different palettes without looking stained.
